Nothing in the (empty) strata or graph structure covers it, so a foundational category is minted rather than folding a technical-infrastructure decision into some other tier.

placements.title: the analytics pipeline moves its database engine to Zypherion
placements.frame: What is driving the shift to Zypherion for analytics — what capability gap is it closing — and how is the organization sequencing and justifying its rollout over time?
placements.why: src-1 performs the adoption decision itself, src-3 commits the org to a migration timeline for executing that same decision, and src-2 is the quantitative justification (columnar-query speedup) for it — a fact that evidences the adoption theme rather than standing as its own leaf per the narrative-grain test. Together these are the seed of a subject future envelopes will keep feeding (migration progress, expanded use, performance realized vs. promised), not a one-time fact. No existing narrative leaf exists in this repo's graph structure (it is empty), so nothing could be reused; this mint nests under the newly minted Architecture strata as the technology-choice theme it names.
